configuration.kinematics: Measured arm positions are written into qpos and mj_kinematics updates the site. mj_step is not called.
configuration.frames: Hardware Cartesian positions are the driver end-effector frame in the driver base frame. The simulated pose is the training TCP site in the body that carries the first arm joint. The scene base pose is not applied.
configuration.position_residual: Simulated TCP position minus the hardware tool position, in the base frame, in millimetres.
configuration.orientation_residual: Angle, in degrees, of the rotation that takes the hardware tool frame onto the simulated TCP frame.
configuration.gripper: Carriage joints stay at the compiled default. The TCP site does not move with them. Each sample still keeps the hardware gripper reading.

hardware_configuration.snapshot_source: Each sample is one get_robot_output() call: header, arm joints, gripper joint, and Cartesian pose and velocity. host_time_s is the host clock immediately after that call returned. Cartesian positions are the driver end-effector frame in the driver base frame: translation in metres, then angle-axis rotation in radians.

end_effector_properties.finger_offset_meaning: offset_finger_left/right are the palm-centre to carriage-centre offsets with the fingers at the closed configuration, in metres. They are not the gripper joint coordinate.
